name: Research your competitors with one AI agent and looot and save a page per competitor in Notion

parameters.content:
## Research your competitors into Notion with one agent

### How it works
1. You set your company domain in **Your company**, and optionally the competitors to look at.
2. One AI agent finds competitors on Google if you listed none, then for each one pulls company data, reads its website and pricing page, checks recent news and review sites, all through looot.
3. Each competitor becomes a Notion page with overview, size and funding, pricing, products, news, what customers say and sources.

One looot credential replaces the Exa, Firecrawl and SerpAPI accounts this kind of workflow usually needs.

**Cost per run**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: company data $0.0019 per lookup, Google results $0.0009 to $0.001, news $0.001, a page read from $0.0002. Three competitors take about 20 calls, around $0.02 in data. Each call is capped at $0.03 and the agent at 40 steps, so a run can never spend more than $1.20. Model tokens are billed by OpenAI.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- An OpenAI credential.
- A Notion integration with access to a database that has a Name title property. Set the database ID in **Save to Notion**.
- Self-hosted n8n: set `N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ALLOW_TOOL_USAGE=true`.

### Customization
Change the fields in **Competitor format** and the agent's system message together. Swap the manual trigger for a weekly schedule.

options.systemMessage:
You research competitors for a sales and marketing team.
If no competitors are given: read the company's homepage with job:web.scrape.markdown, then search Google with job:google.serp.organic for "<product category> alternatives" and pick the closest direct competitors.
For each competitor:
- job:company.enrich with {"domain": "..."} for size, funding and industry.
- job:web.scrape.markdown on the homepage and the pricing page.
- job:news.search with {"query": "\"<name>\""} for the last months.
- job:google.serp.organic with {"query": "<name> reviews g2 OR capterra"} and read one review page.
Only report what the sources say and list every URL you used.

parameters.toolDescription:
Runs one looot data call and returns the run: status, result and actualCost. Every call is capped. Use only these ids and inputs:
- job:company.enrich, input {"domain": "example.com"}: company size, industry, funding, location.
- job:google.serp.organic, input {"query": "..."}: Google organic results.
- job:news.search, input {"query": "..."}: Google News articles.
- job:web.scrape.markdown, input {"url": "https://..."}: one page as text.

parameters.content:
## Who to research
Your domain and, if you want, a fixed list of competitors.

## Find and research
One agent, one data tool. Company data, websites, news and reviews all come from looot.

## One Notion page each
Each page ends with its share of the data cost.
